goal: Takaro-controlled Conan Exiles server/client mod path replacing Pippi chat bridge with every supportable Takaro connector feature validated

statuses.connector-live-supported: Feature is supported by the Conan sidecar/RCON/save-DB/log runtime and can remain outside the TakaroConan chat mod.
statuses.takaro-mod-required: Feature must be re-proven through the TakaroConan mod because current proof depends on Pippi or the host poller.
statuses.schema-fallback: Feature intentionally returns a Takaro DTO-compatible fallback because Conan does not expose the underlying data.
statuses.unsupported: Feature is intentionally unsupported with a structured error.
statuses.approval-gated-live-supported: Feature is supported but destructive or disruptive; proof requires explicit approval or disposable server state.

testReachability.reason: RCON help verifies reachability and is independent of the Pippi chat renderer.

getPlayers.reason: RCON listplayers is independent of the Pippi chat renderer.

getPlayer.finalProofGate: source tests plus MCP player lookup when player is online
getPlayer.reason: Single-player lookup derives from the same RCON identity source as getPlayers.

getPlayerLocation.finalProofGate: source tests plus optional live MCP player location when player is online
getPlayerLocation.reason: Save DB location reads are independent of the chat renderer.

getPlayerInventory.finalProofGate: source tests plus optional live MCP inventory when player save data is available
getPlayerInventory.reason: Save DB inventory reads are independent of the chat renderer.

listItems.finalProofGate: source tests and save DB live verifier
listItems.reason: Item discovery reads configured Conan save DB.

listEntities.finalProofGate: source tests and save DB live verifier
listEntities.reason: Entity discovery reads configured Conan save DB.

listLocations.finalProofGate: source tests and save DB live verifier
listLocations.reason: Location discovery reads configured Conan save DB.

listBans.reason: RCON listbans is independent of the Pippi chat renderer.

getMapInfo.reason: Conan map metadata is not exposed; disabled map info is the intentional Takaro DTO-compatible fallback.

getMapTile.reason: Conan map tile rendering is not exposed by the current runtime.

executeConsoleCommand.reason: Raw command execution routes to RCON and is independent of the chat renderer.

sendMessage.reason: Current live proof uses Pippi server/directmessage through the host poller; final proof must show TakaroConan renders server-wide and targeted normal chat without Pippi.

giveItem.finalProofGate: explicit approval or disposable server mutation smoke
giveItem.reason: Conan supports SpawnItem through RCON con relay, but it mutates player inventory.

teleportPlayer.finalProofGate: explicit approval or disposable server mutation smoke
teleportPlayer.reason: Conan supports TeleportPlayer through RCON con relay, but it mutates player location.

kickPlayer.finalProofGate: explicit approval or disposable server moderation smoke
kickPlayer.reason: Conan supports kickplayer, but it disconnects a real player.

banPlayer.finalProofGate: explicit approval or disposable server moderation smoke
banPlayer.reason: Conan supports banplayer, but it changes moderation state.

unbanPlayer.finalProofGate: explicit approval or disposable server moderation smoke
unbanPlayer.reason: Conan supports unbanplayer and cleanup was live-tested, but it changes moderation state.

shutdown.finalProofGate: explicit approval or disposable server shutdown smoke
shutdown.reason: Conan supports shutdown over RCON, but it stops the dedicated server.

player-connected.finalProofGate: safe live MCP/API verifier plus log/event loop
player-connected.reason: Player polling from RCON listplayers is independent of the Pippi chat renderer.

player-disconnected.finalProofGate: safe live MCP/API verifier plus reconnect/disconnect smoke
player-disconnected.reason: Disconnect deltas derive from RCON listplayers.

chat-message.reason: Current live proof uses Pippi ChatWindow logs; final proof must show /mod/event source TakaroConan with stable player identity.

player-death.finalProofGate: source tests plus log tailer evidence
player-death.reason: Conan death lines are parsed from server logs independent of the chat renderer.

entity-killed.finalProofGate: source tests plus log tailer evidence
entity-killed.reason: Conan entity-killed lines are parsed from server logs independent of the chat renderer.

log.finalProofGate: safe live MCP/API verifier plus log tailer evidence
log.reason: Raw log events are produced by configured log tailers.
